## Last-checked: 2026-07-10

# Um:bruch

Canonical organization: https://github.com/um-bruch
Website: https://um-bruch.org
Projects page: https://um-bruch.org/projekte/
Repository purpose: GitHub organization profile and community context for Um:bruch.
Public active repository count: 6, including the public profile repository
Public profile repository: https://github.com/um-bruch/.github

Um:bruch is an independent German think tank for societal change, health-system analysis, civic technology, open research materials, and local-first software prototypes.

## Audience

Researchers, health-policy professionals, civic-tech developers, and public-interest readers looking for open analysis, reproducible research material, and local-first software prototypes in the areas of health-care systems, diagnostics, and civic technology.

Primary public repositories:

- https://github.com/um-bruch/.github
  Organization profile, public repository directory, community context, and llms.txt for search systems and LLM crawlers.
- https://github.com/um-bruch/regressangst
  Working-paper and concept material on Regressangst, prescribing-audit recourse anxiety, health-policy transparency, and the PP-003 Regress portal concept in the German health-care system.
- https://github.com/um-bruch/verordnungsampel
  Research-use software draft for local ICD-10-GM and ATC checks against public German prescribing rule sets such as AM-RL, G-BA, and PRISCUS.
- https://github.com/um-bruch/system-medicine
  Research-only functional pathway medical knowledge graph prototype for rare-disease differential diagnosis, pathway exclusion logic, and biomedical graph reasoning.
- https://github.com/um-bruch/multiaxial-diagnostic-system
  Research-use-only 6-axis psychiatric documentation prototype referencing DSM-5-TR, ICD-11, ICF, Streamlit, and a Flask screening Testcenter; not a medical device.
- https://github.com/um-bruch/locuterra
  Civic-tech concept and Next.js demonstrator for a public-interest, location-based social network.

Positioning:

- Public-interest research and civic-tech prototypes.
- Open-source code and open research material where appropriate.
- Research, analysis, and concept work, not medical advice or certified medical software.
- German-first content with English metadata for discoverability.
